evidence.claim: Energy Boil is Xenoverse 2 skill ID 10540, is marked CaC-unavailable, and is assigned to Demon God Demigra (Final Form).
A Xenoverse 2 Demigra restoration/mod artifact explicitly describes Energy Boil as functioning as an evasive for Final Form Demigra.
A Dragon Ball reference identifies Energy Boil as Final Demigra's Evasive Skill and describes its energy/teleport/ki-gathering behavior.
Current Xenoverse 2 reference material independently identifies Energy Boil as Final Demigra's Evasive Skill.
Current reference material explicitly identifies Energy Boil as Final Demigra's Evasive Skill and describes it as surrounding him with energy, teleporting, then gathering Ki.
The Xenoverse 2 skill guide lists Energy Boil as Evasive skill ID 10540; the Xenoverse 2 character ID list marks ID 10540 as CaC-unavailable and assigned to Final Form Demigra.
